title: Kiritani Haruka — Connect Even The Heart〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The day of the solo show

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, Haruka, let's do this!
Let's give this show everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is it possible that she was referring to that tour?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, this is just the beginning!
Try to keep up, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been looking up to a certain idol ever since I was little... I've always wanted to be an idol just like her...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our fans dismissed her at first for being too amateurish and not having an aura... They said so many awful things...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm still just starting out as an idol, I may still end up holding back my friends a little and make them worry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even someone like me was able to stand up here and put on a show! We all took a big step forward!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We've been watching Minori express how she really feels for what feels like forever now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's like the time after I decided to step away from being an idol. She gave me the courage to try again, and she connected with each person in that audience...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Minori's an idol who has the support and adoration of all these people.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The rest of us are well aware that Minori didn't have it easy at first since we all have experience being idols...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But you kept persevering, Minori.
As a result, you gave us an enormous amount of hope and encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's the reason why I'm so happy to be standing on this stage with you today. Because I know this solo show is your big moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, let's keep doing our best...
Together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I really hope she understands what I'm referring to...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I think we've managed to clean up everything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that went faster than expected. I feel kind of sad now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just a second ago, we were performing our own solo show. And now, it's all gone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You still look like you're ready to perform, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, because that show was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you seem awfully energetic today. I remember a certain someone being completely wiped after that first show we did with Nanamin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That happened because I was taken by the moment...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You also seemed a bit dizzy after that fan event we did the other day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. The same thing happened there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I somehow managed to keep it together during today's show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we kinda need you to not lose consciousness during these events, you know!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, we all knew this was going to be a big show, and you ended up doing a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, for some reason, I can recall everything that happened today as we performed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: From the second we started to when we began singing... When I waved at the audience as we greeted them... Everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The smiles I saw on everyone's faces, all their cheers... It's still clear in my head.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think it's a sign that the events and shows we've done up to this point have given you the experience you need to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Also, you seemed to figure out a good way to prepare yourself mentally for today's show. We really couldn't have asked for better results.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Honestly, you were a nervous wreck during the week leading up to our show. I can't believe how you went from that to this. Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, remember what you said during the show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You said, “Let's keep doing our best. Together.” That made me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that case, Minori...
Let's keep singing for as long as we can together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Oh, wait! That reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just out of curiosity...
Do you remember what happened during “HONEY” when you were touring Japan...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? That grin...
Is that a yes or a no?! Please tell me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh geez. Well, I guess that's just the way they are...
